inlines.v: JEST'ING, participle present tense Joking; talking for diversion or merriment. JEST'ING, noun A joking; concise wit; wit that consists in a trope or verbal figure, in a metaphorical sense of words, or in a double sense of the same word, or in similitude of sound in different words.
